description: Z8D168 Cryptographic Library based on Nationz Z8D168 SmartCard IC is a single-chip firmware module providing RSA, TDES, AES, RNG cryptographic service for government and corporate identification, payment, banking and Web applications etc.

capabilities: Core Algorithm: AES-128Key, AES-192Key, AES-256Key, TDES-2Key, TDES-3Key
